title: zea perennis
intro: Zea perennis, commonly known as teosinte, is an annual grass species of the family Poaceae. It is a wild ancestor of domesticated corn (Zea mays) and is native to Central America. Zea perennis is used in traditional medicine, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating digestive issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Zea perennis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
